_comment: The inmates' voice lines (owner, 2026-10-20). Each clip is server/voicelines/<file>.mp3 (ElevenLabs eleven_v4, the flow in
CLAUDE.md's Voice lines bullet), said by <speaker> (the name the scripts pass to storySay/jjSay: Lefty, Rusty, Tank,
Whisper) and <text>: EXACTLY what the recording says. voice.sk plays it when that speaker says that text in person, so
when a script's line changes, its clip stops playing (make-voice-lines.js --check lists it as stale) instead of
saying the old words. match 'prefix': the line only starts with the text (the rest is filled in by the script).
Run tools\node\node.exe tools\make-voice-lines.js after a change (OGGs, sounds.json, voicelines.sk).

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: New fish? Come sit with me in Hall B. Free advice.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Nobody stays in here forever.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Three ways past the fences: a keycard through the police station, C4 on the vehicle gate, or over the fence by the Gun Shop.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Then the lot. The front gate opens from the gatehouse booth: a keycard gets you in, or punch its fuse box when the guards look away.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: First, get yourself sorted.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Putty in the workshop, wires in the supply closet, a timer in the infirmary: hold right-click to search each. Bring me all three and I put it together.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Careful with that. The vehicle gate by the plaza: hold right-click on it to plant it, and you're in the lot.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Knock a guard down, or ask Rusty in B1: he trades for donuts.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Knew you had it in you. Mara runs things out there: find her.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Give me those. There: hold right-click on the vehicle gate by the plaza, then get clear.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Four marks round the yard. Touch them in order; the clock starts at the first.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: One at a time. Use the one you've got.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Free up a hand first.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Mm, chocolate.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Took you long enough. Name's Rusty.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Here, a knife.
lines.where: jailcourse.sk jcRusty (the key is filled in)

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Your phone's in slot 9: press 9 and right-click to open the map. Out in the city it's your GPS; F opens the apps. The door opens from in here when you walk up to it.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Good. The Security Office is down the hall, same keycard. Up the ladder and you're in the main block.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Bring me a donut from the cafeteria counter. I make it worth your while.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Ahh. Here.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Do what I said.

lines.speaker: Rusty
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: Get the guards on your tail, then shake them. I need them looking the other way.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.

lines.speaker: Tank
lines.text: Got it. Whisper sends his regards, huh.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: Somebody hid a stash in the yard. Bring it to me, and keep it away from the guards.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: Nice. Here's your cut.

lines.speaker: Whisper
lines.text: You're not done down there yet.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: New in town? I've got work for someone with nerve. Come see me at the Safehouse.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Heard you broke out. Nice. I've got work for someone with nerve: come see me at the Safehouse.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: So you're the new face.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: No bag, no gun, no ride. Let's fix that.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Here's a lockpick. The Scrap Yard Boss pays cash for cars: go see him.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Your hands hold $1,000 of loot at most. A Gym Bag holds $2,000: get one at the Bag Shop.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Now you can carry a real haul.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Level 5: the Gun Shop will sell you a Classic Pistol now. Time to trade up from the knife.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Nice. Now let's put it to use.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Stores are easy money for new faces: no clock. Smack the clerk, grab the register, and duck whatever they throw at you.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: That's the spirit. Now get out of there.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Loot's worth nothing in a bag. Take it to the base: your GPS knows the way.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Cash in hand. Feels good, huh? Here's a crate key for your trouble.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Guns need a name on the street: level 5. Until then, a knife from the Gun Shop.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Keep it sharp.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Use that key at a crate stand. And grab /daily every day: free keys.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Lucky you.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Keep robbing and selling. Level 5 opens your first gun, the Safe Kit, Street jobs, the Duffel Bag and the medium heists.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Level 5 already? Come by the Safehouse. I've got something for you.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: You've got talent. Most rookies don't make it this far.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Safes hold the good stuff. Here's a Safe Kit: guess the code, green means right.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Or skip the gate: there's a hole by the lot's west fence. Dig under it.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: So which way? Talk to me and pick one: I'll walk you through it. And do the odd job for the others in here: it's a head start.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The vehicle gate by the plaza: hold right-click on it with the C4 in hand. Five seconds, get clear, then through the hole before they rebuild it.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The station's yard door opens as your card walks up. Through the lobby, out the south door: that's the lot. The desk guard watches the doors.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The box by the gate between the Gun Shop and the police station: punch it ten times when no guard's near, or show it a keycard. The gate slides open; the crates in the annex take you over the fence.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: First the lot. No card? The quiet way is the parkour: punch the box by the gate between the Gun Shop and the police station, then over the annex fence.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: West end of the lot, by the fence: down the ladder, hold right-click on the dirt under the fence, and out the other side before it caves in.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: C4 it is. Find me the putty, the wires and a timer.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: A card, then. Get one, and the police station's your door.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Over the fence. Watch for guards near that box.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: Digging. Get into the lot first; the hole's by the west fence.

lines.speaker: Sparks
lines.text: Sharp end out. You didn't get it from me.

lines.speaker: Sparks
lines.text: Keep 'em at arm's length. Longer than that, even.

lines.speaker: Sparks
lines.text: Heavy. Swing it like you mean it.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: The police station's yard door, the Gun Shop and the gatehouse all open for it.

lines.speaker: Lefty
lines.text: That's everything I know. In the lot, open the front gate from the booth, or climb the ladder over the south fence, and go.
